facts_carried_over: Vanessa Lopez is listed as Director, Advising for LSC-Houston North. Source: Lone Star College-Houston North Academic Advising page; accessed 2026-09-15.

LSC-Houston North advising assigns students to advisors and supports personalized educational planning, transfer, career, graduation, and resource referrals. Source: Lone Star College-Houston North Academic Advising page; accessed 2026-09-15.
LSC-Houston North had 4,813 students in the Spring 2026 enrollment report. Source: Lone Star College Institutional Research page; Spring 2026 report, accessed 2026-09-15.
Dr. Sheldon Moss is Vice President Student Success and chief student services officer for LSC-Houston North. Source: Lone Star College Student Complaints page; accessed 2026-09-15.
Reginald Brumfield became Lone Star College System chief information officer effective 2026-01-20. Source: Lone Star College news release dated 2026-01-15.
Lone Star College uses D2L Brightspace as its learning management system. Source: Lone Star College Virtual Teaching Assistance Center page modified 2026-06-11.
Lone Star College publicly documents myLoneStar's My Advisor tile for advisor assignment and appointment scheduling. Source: Lone Star College Academic Advising page; accessed 2026-09-15.
Lone Star College-Houston North is a campus of a public community college system and opened in 2019. Source: Lone Star College-Houston North campus page; accessed 2026-09-15.
Lone Star College's FY2025 annual report states Fall 2025 system credit enrollment of 97,294. Source: FY25 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report, dated 2025-12-31.
